text: __NOTOC__ |-|Battle Royale= Wielding the ancient power of Pandora’s Box, Marvel's armored despot Doctor Doom has transplanted his Latvarian domain to the Battle Royale Island and seized a foothold with his army of loyal henchmen. Once his empowered armor is complete, he’ll reap total control. Doctor Doom and his lieutenants must be defeated! Whatever it takes. Marvel's War Machine, Gwenpool, and the Wakandan royal Shuri join Captain Jones and Peelverine as first on the scene to defend against Doctor Doom and his forces. They’ll need all the help they can get! Suit up for Fortnite Battle Royale Chapter 5 Season 4: Absolute Doom!
Phobos (Greek: Φόβος) is the Olympian God of Fear and Terror, son of Ares and Aphrodite.
Odin's Noose is the magical rope/noose the All-Father used to hang himself.
Thanatos (Greek: Θάνατος) is the Greek Primordial God of Death, and the main antagonist in God of War: Ghost of Sparta. He is the ruler of the Domain of Death and the father of Erinys.

Ali Baba was a cunning rogue from Rabiah Ali Baba, a master of unlocking secrets and breaching defenses that others deemed impenetrable. With a simple utterance of "Open, Sesame!", he could cause the most formidable barriers to yield, revealing the hidden treasures and mysteries beyond.

Ayesha Tanaka was the armorer of Tetsuo Umezawa and the teacher of Kei Takahashi, whom she had taken from his abusive foster family. She knew blue and white magic and had been born with the ability to destroy artifacts and enchantments with only her willpower.
Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar (IPA: /æzməɹænoʊmɑɹdɪkədaɪstɪnəkuldəkɑɹ/), or Asmor for short, was a female wizard and a great cook from Dominaria.

Azor is a sphinx of unknown origin and a former planeswalker. He is a lawmage and a hieromancer and sees himself as the Arbiter of Law. On Ravnica, he is remembered as Supreme Judge Azor I or First Judge Azorius and the parun of the Azorius Senate. On Ixalan, he is known as the legendary Last Guardian of the Immortal Sun.
Ashiok (ASH-ee-ock) is a nightmare-like planeswalker of unknown gender and origin.
Ashaya is an Elemental that Nissa Revane summoned on Zendikar in her fight against the Eldrazi. It is a fragment of Zendikar's worldsoul.
B.O.B, the Bevy of Beebles, is a planeswalker who is composed of a bevy of Beebles.

Banath'thur is a criminal demon from Alara. He has been known as the Demon of Qasal, the Defiler of Souls, and Hell's Lash. He has been wanted for mass destruction and soul corruption throughout Jund, Naya, and Bant. In addition to conspiracy to commit genocide, entering a contract with a minor, forgery, torture, and two counts of destruction of a holy being.
Azamuki (ah-zah-MOO-kee), Treachery Incarnate, is a kami of treachery on Kamigawa that resides inside and influences people.
Autumn-Tail, Kitsune Sage, is a kitsune wizard of Kamigawa during the time of the Kami War.

Azlask is an Eldrazi that is able to boost Spawns and Scions to become terrible annihilators. Since it seems to be pure Ulamog brood rather than a corrupted form of native creature, it was likely present on Zendikar during the Rise of the Eldrazi.
Baas is a one-armed ogre shaman and tattoo artist, part of the Ghor clan of Gruul.
Bruna, the Light of Alabaster, was an Angel from Innistrad. She was the leader of the Flight of Alabaster. She was eldrazified by Emrakul.

Brudiclad is a Myr-like compleated artifact creature who is able to meld flesh and metal in glorious harmony. During the Time Spiral crisis he was transported through a time rift from a possible future to Dominaria. That future came to pass when, during New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse, he fought on the side of the invaders.
Byode is a planeswalker of an unspecified species, who can travel between separate Universes rather than planes. Due to this they are called a Universewalker. They are black/blue aligned.
Bright-Palm, Soul Awakener, is a kitsune shaman of Kamigawa.
The Buried Lord, also called the Lord of the Interred, is a demon from Innistrad who was briefly returned to life before being banished by Liesa.
Clavileño was a Legion of Dusk vampire cleric from Ixalan. He was granted demonic power by Aclazotz before his death.
Coernn was a sorcerer in the Dark Age of Terisiare, on the plane of Dominaria.

Crosis is one of the five Primeval Dragons of Dominaria. He was birthed by Piru and sired by Chromium Rhuell. His name means "death" in the ancient draconic language, and he is known as "The Purger." Crosis is a jet-black dragon who would slay his enemies by screaming the word of death, which caused anyone that heard it to instantly die. During the Fall of the Primevals, Crosis was imprisoned in a tar pit in Urborg by the black Numena Kuberr. He was freed thousands of years later by the other four Primevals, who sacrificed themselves to release him. Upon doing so, Crosis resurrected the others, completing the pantheon. Crosis was trapped again soon afterward following the deaths of Rith and
The Cuombajj Witches of Rabiah are sorceresses that can wield potent blood magic. They have a saying: "All things are connected: light to dark, age to youth, blood to blood."
Daria was a young human girl from Ulgrotha whose planeswalker's spark triggered early in life. She was recruited by Urza as one of the Nine Titans.
Dina is a dryad mage-student at the Witherbloom College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios.
The Daughers of Autumn are beings of the Great Wood on Ulgrotha, 'daughters' or lesser avatars of the nature spirit Autumn Willow.
Dralnu was an undead necromancer from Urborg who aided the Coalition forces before betraying them. He bore a remarkable resemblance to the metathran commander Thaddeus.

Eladamri was the leader of the Skyshroud elves of Rath during the reigns of Volrath and Crovax. Though he was a skilled warrior, his greatest talent was his leadership, which he used first to unite the people of Rath in resistance against the evincars and later to tie together the various peoples of the Coalition on Dominaria.
Elenda of Garrano, also known as the first vampire, the Dusk Rose or Black Rose, and Saint Elenda the Venerable is the legendary ancestor of the vampires of the Legion of Dusk on Ixalan.
Egon is the god of death from Kaldheim. When attempting to enter Starnheim, he disguised himself as the human Bjorn.
Eleni is an elf from Naya, who became a berserker in Jund after the Conflux.
Extus Narr was a shadowy figure on Arcavios. He lurked in the shadows of Strixhaven and was the head of the Oriq.
Eruth of Lambholt is a young woman from Innistrad who gained notoriety for her clairvoyant dreams. She is now a gibbering lunatic living in the Natternols.
Ersta is a planeswalker unicorn, who is friendly to wizards. They are multicolor aligned.
Ertha Jo is a kor advisor line-slinger from Zendikar who traveled to Thunder Junction following the opening of the Omenpaths.
Eris is an elemental warlock who arrived on Thunder Junction after the opening of the Omenpaths.

Emilya was a 14-year-old girl and member of the Orzhov guild, who became a ghost after her death at the hands of the Cult of Rakdos. She has returned to life again by the touch of a nephilim and seeks vengeance on her former guild.
Feroz was a planeswalker that thought using summoned beings was immoral.
Garth (born Galin, nicknamed One-Eye) was a powerful wizard and planeswalker from Kush on Dominaria.
Flann was an ash treefolk of Lorwyn, known to most as the Wanderer, a giver of great knowledge.
Glacian was an ancient Thran artificer who designed many of the Thran Empire's most powerful artifacts, including the powerstones on which Thran technology was based.

The planeswalker Grenfell Mor was of the founding sages of Minorad on Dominaria, and an advisor to the queen of Corundis. He was the father of Gwendolyn Carthalion (née Mor) and the grandfather of Jared Carthalion.
Griselbrand was one of the demonic masters of Liliana Vess. He granted her the power over death.
Gisa Cecani (Gee-sah Seh-sahn-nee) is a black-aligned necromancer from Innistrad. She has a rivalry with her twin brother Geralf Cecani.
Ghen is a Human Wizard from an unknown plane. He has the ability to manipulate the strands of mana that make up an enchantment.
Grist, known as the Hunger Tide, is an insect planeswalker from an undisclosed plane.
Gimbal is a gremlin artificer from Avishkar who fought in defense of the plane.
Genku is a moonfolk wizard from Kamigawa. He was the husband of Tamiyo.
Gravelighter is a kami from Kamigawa. It is the kami of forgotten clearings.
Hakim Loreweaver was a historian and wizard from Suq’Ata on Dominaria. A charming and knowledgeable man, but also a bit of a braggart, he was called Loreweaver for his gift for telling stories.

Hivis of the Scale was a Viashino from the Great Desert of Dominaria. He was an ally of Jolrael. Hivis hailed from the vast reaches and possessed an uncanny ability to make dragons loyal to him, while his counterpart Zirilan of the Claw could lead the winged serpents. During the Mirage Wars, Hivis was able to lead viashino armies into Zhalfir, Femeref, and Suq'Ata, but was forced back after Jolrael defected from Kaervek's side.
Haakon was the undead leader of the Order of Stromgald in Terisiare and lord of Tresserhorn.
Hapatra, a.k.a. Rhonas's broken fang, was the vizier of the god Rhonas on Amonkhet.
Hikari (hee-KAH-ree; ) was a kami from Kamigawa, the guardian of the border between day and night.
Hatificer is a acorn creature class of those that fight while wearing magical hats.
Henrika Domnathi is the progenitor of the minor Domnathi vampire bloodline on Innistrad. She is the rumored one-time lover of Griselbrand.
Horobi (hoh-ROH-bee), Death's Wail, is a kami of death from Kamigawa.
Helga is a frogfolk hedgewitch from Bloomburrow, and a member of Mabel’s party.
Hogaak is a legendary avatar of graves from an unknown plane.
Ixidor was a powerful wizard and well-known pit champion from Dominaria.
Jeleva is a vampire wizard that lives in the Nephalia region of Innistrad.
Jiang Yanggu is a planeswalker boy from Shenmeng, who is always accompanied by a sapient dog named Mowu.
Jacob Hauken is a human detective from Nephalia, Innistrad. He is a geist-talker, and investigator of geist-related incidents.
Iname (ee-NAH-may) is the kami of life and death on Kamigawa.
Keiga, the Tide Star (KAY-gah; ), was the great ryuu (divine dragon) of Kamigawa's islands. Keiga guarded Minamo and the Kamitaki Falls, and has since reincarnated as Kairi.
Kangee, was an aven wizard from Dominaria and a prominent member of The Order.

Kambal is a corrupt human who once oversaw the distribution of the aether on Avishkar. He exercised all the power necessary to maintain his dominion and his fortune. He was allied with Baral and Tezzeret when he kidnapped the best inventors from the Inventors' Fair. He serves as the mayor of the city of Prosperity on Thunder Junction.
The lion-headed Ketramose is the Amonkheti god of the breaking dawn.
Kristina of the Woods was a planeswalker native to Corondor on Dominaria, whose planeswalker's spark manifested after the creation of the Shard of the Twelve Worlds.
Kirlen was an old wizard and the master of the House of Bolk in the city of Estark, in Kush, on Dominaria.

Kiel was a brother of Brion Stoutarm and Rosheen Meanderer. He was said to have some prophetic talents, which is not surprising given that Rosheen was the most renowned giant oracle on Lorwyn. He was quite silent and thoughtful. Brion and Kiel were once hired by Rhys to help eliminate a boggart raiding party. Rhys was then ordered by Nath to send the giants away, but they refused to leave until the work was done. In the end, they agreed to leave if Rhys brought stories to their sister, who should be present at the Aurora celebration in Kinsbaile. Rhys later met the giant brothers near Kinsbaile. However, the group was ambushed during their talk by the Gilt Leaf pursuit commando, and both wer
Kokusho, the Evening Star (KOH-koo-shoh; ), was the great ryuu (divine dragon) of Kamigawa's swamps. She guarded Takenuma and has since reincarnated as Junji, who is male.

Kula was an anchorite (a form of religious hermit and druid) from Dominaria. She was six and a half feet tall, with a broad skull and nut-brown skin, and dressed like a jungle dweller, in leather skins, carrying bone fetishes. Kula was very good at spotting lies.
Shaper Kopala, Warden of Waves, is a introspective wizard of the River Heralds on Ixalan. He is the youngest of the Nine Shapers.
Kroxa is the titan of Death's Hunger, on the plane of Theros.
Kwain is a rabbitfolk wizard from Bloomburrow who first appeared in Commander Legends.
Killian Lu is a human mage-student in his second year at the Silverquill College at Strixhaven University on Arcavios. He is called Killy by his friends.
Leighbet is a former Izzet inventor who discovered a way of administering electrical immunity.
Kitsa is a legendary otter wizard from Bloomburrow and an Otterball Elite.

Lim-Dûl (/lɪm dul/ LIHM-dool) was a powerful necromancer who terrorized Terisiare during the Ice Age. The fragment of his essence contained within the Ring of Mairsil is known as The Raven Man. He conducted two major campaigns to take over the mana-rich plane of Shandalar and orchestrated Liliana Vess's procurement of the Chain Veil.
The Lord of Tresserhorn, was an undead replacement for Lim-Dûl, created by Chaeska after Lim-Dûl's Battle.
Maga (MAH-gah; ) was a Wizard from the Minamo on Kamigawa, with a passion for oni magic.

Princess Lucrezia was a legendary human wizard, who ruled a city-state of the same name in south-western Jamuraa, four centuries after the Ice Age. Her city was constantly at war with the shah of Fysmatan, another port city on the shore of the Sea of Serenity. Lucrezian marines, an elite unit of her navy, were one of the most disciplined forces to sail the sea. During one of the numerous wars between Fysmatan and Lucrezia, the latter was also opposed by the Robaran Mercenaries, led by Adira Strongheart. After having found out that Lucrezian marines had enslaved a tribe of island natives to build a flotilla of warships, the Robaran Mercenaries attacked the marines and freed the slaves, sellin
Licia, Sanguine Tribune is a legendary vampire soldier from an unknown plane.

Liesa, the Shroud of Dusk, is an archangel from Innistrad. Her entire Flight of Dusk was killed by Avacyn after they sided with a demon lord a millennium ago. Considered apocryphal by the Church of Avacyn, she is not acknowledged with her sisters.

Rukarumel was a Rift Era human biologist and wizard who made it her life's work to study the slivers that had come to Dominaria from Rath and their evolution's many forms. She could grow base slivers in her specimen lab and expose them to different varieties of captured slivers that she kept in glass containers. Rukarumel wore a biologist's robes and glasses and wore her wild black hair cut at the neck. In her inspections, she used numerous apparatuses with focal lenses and kept vigorous field notes on many types of slivers.
Samor was a the leader of the Sumifan songmages during the Brothers' War.
Rendclaw is a wickerfolk from Duskmourn, bonded with a murder of crows.
Sacumon was a sorceress in the Dark Age of Terisiare, on the plane of Dominaria.
Shauku, also known as the Endbringer, is an ancient vampire of Femeref descent.
Satya is a human artificer from Avishkar. A genius inventor, Satya created the , earning him the moniker "Aetherflux Genius."

Slobad was a Mirran goblin with an unusual affinity with artifacts and an even stranger way of speaking. He was reanimated into a Phyrexian as of the Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria and Phyrexia: All Will Be One.
Sol'Kanar, called The Swamp King and the Demon King of Corondor, was a Force of Nature from Dominaria, which was corrupted by Geyadrone Dihada.
Skullbriar the Walking Grave is a legendary zombie elemental from an unspecified plane.
Simun the Quiet was a brilliant wizard from an unknown plane. He was quite mad.

Skavius Slan was a lich on Shandalar, who used the empty body of Azar after the Wizard's War. The lichlord took command of the Black Guild and ruled for ages, even after the passing of the other Guildlords of Shandalar.
King Suleiman was an ancient king of Rabiah before the Thousandfold Refraction, esteemed for his wisdom and the many Djinni and Efreeti he had imprisoned.
Tacenda Verlasen is a songmage and possible planeswalker from Innistrad.
Strefan Maurer is the progenitor of the minor Maurer vampiric bloodline from Innistrad. He rules a remote region in Stensia's outland valleys.
Starcryst, the Astral Visionary was a mysterious merfolk on Shandalar, who took command of the Blue Guild until its downfall.
Tariel, Reckoner of Souls, is a legendary angel from an unknown plane.
Thatu Reiniger was a vampire lord and wielder of the Bloodletter on the plane of Innistrad.
Thabit of Almaaz was a Dominarian human song-mage from Almaaz who organized the Uprising in Epityr, a successful rebellion against the Sheoltuns.

Toshiro Umezawa (TOH-shee-roh oo-meh-ZAH-wah; ; known as Toshi for short) was a ronin samurai, kanji magician and con artist from Kamigawa who lived during the Kami War. Whilst he was mainly interested in self-preservation, he became embroiled in the war's events and ultimately played a key role in ending it.

Tomik Vrona is a law and security mage from Ravnica. He is chief advokist of the Orzhov Syndicate, and the former apprentice of Teysa Karlov. He served as acting guildmaster after the War of the Spark, but has since become second to Teysa.
The Unluckiest is an unnamed planeswalker from an undefined plane, who is cursed with bad luck.
Tivash, Gloom Summoner, is a human warlock teacher at the Witherbloom College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios.

The Traveler, also known in Tazeem as the Outsider, in Tolaria as the Visitor, in Gavony as the Butcher of Crussebourg, and in Shiv as the Hero of Old Onkoom, is the moniker for the player-created human planeswalker that was introduced in the Magic: Legends computer game. The cause for the Traveler's spark is currently unknown, and their name, gender, and appearance, as well as their power set, are determined by the player. Non-player characters style the planeswalker as the "Traveler" throughout the game except in Tazeem, where the inhabitants address the person as the "Outsider".
Trenz is a white-haired Izzet chemister with a crooked nose from Ravnica, who performed an Epic Experiment for Niv-Mizzet.
Uyo (OO-yoh; ) was the greatest of soratami seers and prophets, and one of the highest-ranked persona in the soratami hierarchy on Kamigawa.

Tymaret, known by the humans of Theros as The Murder King, is an undead warrior and the de facto leader of Odunos, the polis inhabited by the more violent Returned who have escaped the clutches of the plane's Underworld and its God Erebos. Tymaret commands its best warriors in organized raids against the living. Their raids are small but effective, and almost always nocturnal.
Vannemir was a Terisian warrior who was raised from the dead to fulfill his destiny and save his world from being destroyed by Heidar.
Veko is a spirit priest aligned with the Orzhov, known for his role in manipulating life and death.
Volpaig was a bishop of the Church of Avacyn, and secretly the leader of the Skirsdag Cult on the plane of Innistrad.

Worrin Betzold was a human bishop, and the father of Dennick Betzold. After his death he became a zombie, mindlessly still preaching his sermons to the undead hordes swarming Thraben. He was a native of Gavony, Innistrad.
Vytas was a noble and an Umbris cultist from Traublassen, Innistrad.
Zur, known as Zur the Enchanter or as Zur the Mad, is a powerful wizard, prominent during the Dominarian Ice Age.
Zakk was a wizard of unknown origin who fought Kazz, as mentioned in the Rivals Quick Start Set. She also appeared in the Summer Magic intro along with her rival.
Yedora, Grave Gardener, is a treefolk druid teacher at the Witherbloom College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios.
Yukora (YOO-koh-rah), the Prisoner, is a oni kami of kamigawa.
Champion Zahur is a leonin zombie warrior charioteer from Amonkhet. He originates from the lost era before Nicol Bolas.

An outer-space life form discovered in Saturn's rings, believed to have drifted into the solar system from deep space in ancient times. Life activity has ceased since its discovery, and it is preserved in a fossil-like state. Its bodily structure is composed of unknown substances that do not exist within the solar system, and research has been ongoing for many years.
Spartan Edward Malcolm Buck (SN: 92458-37017-EB) is a SPARTAN-IV and a former Orbital Drop Shock Trooper.
The Glass Eater is a fictional character in Perdita's Story. He is a circus freak, literally a man who eats glass, along with the Broken Lady and the Electric Weasels.

Makee is an orphaned human who was raised by the alien Covenant and shared their contempt for humanity. She was a Blessed One, capable of activating ancient artifacts that are critical in the Covenant religion.

The Proto-Gravemind, also known as the Proto-Compound Intelligence, is an advanced Flood form created from the biomass of the most intelligent living organisms available, with the ultimate goal of creating a fully-functional Gravemind.

Anyame technique is a Sangheili fighting technique developed by Xaebho 'Anyame, an esteemed swordsman. The technique requires its users to move in an extremely systematic sequence to allow them to quickly detect an opponent's strengths and weaknesses by mentally cataloging said opponent's blocks to the user's feints and attacks. 'Anyame technique is taught by Xaebho 'Anyame in the fortress of Deithvo. All Sangheili warriors living in Sumai keep, including Usze 'Taham, are familiar with the method and are taught to counter it by feigning incompetence. Otar 'Bemet was a skilled user of this technique.
Argie was an ancilla created as a remote aspect of the Forerunner archeon-class ancilla Intrepid Eye.
The Eklon'Dal World Patroller is a Lich variant employed by the Banished in their campaigns against their enemies.
The Spawner is a Flood pure form. They serve the Flood as mobile gestation pods, creating new forms of Flood in the field as the situation requires.

Growth-Through-Trial-of-Change, or simply Trial, was a Forerunner Lifeworker. She was one of the few Forerunners to survive the activation of the Halo Array, although she would ultimately sacrifice her life in order to repair the Domain.
Invariant Bias is a Contender-class ancilla that serves as the custodian of the Absolute Record.
Newman was a SPARTAN-IV supersoldier and a member of Fireteam Jackknife.
Oriel was an ancilla created as a remote aspect of the Forerunner archeon-class ancilla Intrepid Eye.
Pegoras was the personal Lich of the Banished warmaster, Atriox.
The panthedron is a large, predatory feline which uses echolocation to hunt in the dense forests of Boundary's fertile equatorial band.
R. D. Verrat is a SPARTAN-IV who serves with Fireteam Forest on the .
Sundered Psalm is a Lich currently in service under the Shields of Requiem.

Wise-Hands-to-Forge was a powerful Forerunner Builder. He and his guild designed the original twelve Halo rings under the orders of the Master Builder, Faber. He was married to Maker-of-Cherished-Mountains, another Builder, with whom he had several children, including Bornstellar Makes Eternal Lasting and his sister.

, the worldmaster of the Netherop.]] Worldmaster is a title given to Nizat 'Kvarosee by Tam 'Lakosee after their exile on Netherop, reflecting Nizat's leadership of the rogue Covenant forces stranded on the world.

Xaebho 'Anyame is an esteemed Sangheili swordsman. He developed the 'Anyame technique, a Sangheili fighting method that allows its users to quickly learn their opponents strengths and weaknesses in combat. 'Anyame personally taught his technique to Sangheili warriors, including Otar 'Bemet, in the fortress of Deithvo.

Lodar is the main villain of the minicomic Slave City! He took the city of Targa with his army of Kobolds and enslaved the population. When the Kobolds captured an amnesiac He-Man, he made him fight Garn, another prisoner, in the arena, the victor being set free. He-Man recovers his memory and wins, but he refuses to kill his competitor. Instead, he attacks Lodar and wins. The Kobolds flee at the sight of their master losing. Afterwards, Lodar and the Kobolds are banished underground, where Lodar will no longer be able to use magic without the sun and the moon, from which he draws his power.
Mouse-Jaw Evil & Armed with M.O.U.S.E.R., is an evil character in the Turtles of Grayskull action figure line and mini-comics. He is a variation of Trap Jaw.

The Pelleezeeans are a race of mammalian humanoid creature native to the planet of Eternia. The most notable member of the race was Odiphus as a young boy, and it is revealed he is from a race of creatures called the Pelleezeans, who populate a small village named Pelleezeea. Odiphus had desired to be a criminal ever since his childhood, and as a child betrayed his people by telling the invading warlord Prahvus where the Paleezeans kept their weapons. Unfortunately for both of them, the Sorceress of Castle Grayskull happened to be in the town, caring for an injured soldier. A chemical accident mutated Odiphus into Stinkor and gave him his horrible stench. Stinkor himself is not immune to his

is a Stand developed by Enrico Pucci, featured in Stone Ocean. C-MOON is the evolved form of Whitesnake and the predecessor to Made in Heaven. This Stand is the result of the fusion between Pucci and the Green Baby, resulting an ability that gives C-MOON and Pucci the power to manipulate gravity and turn things and people inside out.
, sometimes stylized as "DEATH 13", is the Stand of Mannish Boy; featured in Stardust Crusaders.

: is a core ally featured in JoJo Part 6: Stone Ocean. Emporio is a young Stand User, born and living secretly in Green Dolphin Street Prison. He sympathizes with Jolyne and becomes one of her primary allies. Emporio's Stand is the ghost room, Burning Down the House.

The are an unnamed group of minor antagonists featured in Steel Ball Run. As Funny Valentine's henchmen, they stalk and attack Johnny Joestar and Gyro Zeppeli during the 5th stage of the Steel Ball Run to take their Saint's Corpse parts. They are all Stand Users that share the same Stand, Tatoo You!

Goyathlay Soundman (ゴヤスレー・サウンドマン Goyasurē saundoman) is a character featured in the light novel JORGE JOESTAR. He is a counterpart of Sandman from the 37th universe, and wields the Bound, Dune. He was an astronaut who boarded the H.G. Wells, along with Captain Funnier Valentine who later betrayed and killed him.

Fukashigi Nijimura (虹村ふかしぎ - Niji-mura fukashigi) is an ally in the light novel JORGE JOESTAR from the 37th universe. He is a Stand User who wields the Stand NYPD Blue, and is the twin brother of Muryotaisu Nijimura. He is an ally of Joji Joestar and helps him search for Yoshikage Kira along with Koji Hirose. He is the one of the alternates of the Nijimura Brothers from the original universe after their world had been reset thirty-six times by Made In Heaven.

President Funnier Valentine (おかしなバレンタイン - Okashina Barentain) is a minor antagonist from the light novel JORGE JOESTAR. He is from the 37th universe and is the user of the Stand, Rear Window. He is an old astronaut, piloting the manned flight to Mars and its secret third moon. He is the son of Funny Valentine, and the father of The Funniest Valentine.
is a minor character featured in Stardust Crusaders. He is an ordinary barber and is possessed by Anubis as he gives Polnareff a shave. Consequently, he battles both Polnareff and Jotaro.

Koji Hirose (広瀬 康司 Hirose Kōji) is a major ally featured in the light novel JORGE JOESTAR. Koji Hirose is one of the characters that Joji meets in the 37th universe and later helps him find Yoshikage Kira. Koji is also the user of the Stand, Blue Thunder.
The is a enemy Stand user exclusively featured in Chapter 2 of Volume 1 of the Drama CD, based on Stardust Crusaders. His real name is unknown.

is a major ally featured in the light novel JORGE JOESTAR. He is from the 37th universe in Morioh; he is also the counterpart of the Nijimura Brothers, and assists in searching for Yoshikage Kira with Jorge. He is the twin brother of Fukashigi and is the wielder of the Stand Grand Bleu.

Mass Hysteria (集団ヒステリー Shūdan Hisuterī) is a strange phenomenal creature that appears throughout the light novel JORGE JOESTAR. It is directly based off of an [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mass_psychogenic_illness illness with the same name], and has a similar function.

is the Stand of Wild Cat Size, featured in the ninth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, The JOJOLands. It manifests strings—also called wires—that automatically wrap around a victim's limbs and dig into their flesh.

is a secondary antagonist featured in Lonesome Tim, a light novel based on Steel Ball Run. A Stand user working alongside Reed Whipman, he uses Lazy Write-Down P to claim ownership over objects and corpses, even viewing orphans like Standing Little Bear as nothing more than property to be collected.

is a secondary antagonist featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable, specifically in the "Let's Go Hunting!" story arc. Bug-Eaten is a rat nicknamed by Jotaro. It and its companion were struck with an Arrow by Akira Otoishi, turning them both into Stand users with identical sniping Stands, both named Ratt. Jotaro Kujo and Josuke Higashikata hunt it down before it can procreate and make a swarm of rat Stand users.

is a primary ally featured in Purple Haze Feedback, a light novel based on Vento Aureo. Aside from being the supervisor and sole member of Passione's data analysis team, he is a Stand user who wields the omniscient All Along Watchtower in tracking Sezione Droghe's location.

An unnamed girl who appears as a tertiary antagonist featured in the ninth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, The JOJOLands. She is a student from an affluent family who bullies Dragona Joestar during high school, causing Dragona and Jodio to awaken their Stands.

, frequently shortened to , is the Stand of Fernando Arjón, featured in the light novel El Aleph. It allows Arjón to alter the compositions of any organism or object by exchanging parts belonging to them.

This unnamed Stand possessed by Holy Kujo is featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders. It is a fern-like Stand that manifests after DIO's awakening. However, due to Holy's gentle nature, the Stand goes out of control and begins debilitating its user.

The is an unnamed secondary antagonist featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders, specifically the "Dark Blue Moon" story arc. He is an assassin sent by DIO who fights the Joestar Group in the middle of the ocean on their way to Egypt. He is a Stand user and wields Dark Blue Moon.

The unnamed is a tertiary character featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, specifically in the "Soft & Wet" story arc. She is a tourist from Tokyo who was kidnapped and put under the control of Ojiro Sasame's Stand, Fun Fun Fun, to be used as bait for Yoshikage Kira.

is the main antagonist of Poker Under Arms. He is a skilled gunman and a card sharp player whom Don Peckinpah challenges in a game of poker. A modern iteration of him also appears in the spin-off series Cool Shock Old B.T. as a secondary antagonist, specifically in "."

The unnamed is a tertiary character featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean. He is a Stand user who unknowingly wields Survivor. He was the original user of the Stand before it was given to Guccio by Whitesnake.
is the main antagonist featured exclusively in the Escape from JoJo's Bizarre Nightmare game attraction. Given a DISC by Whitesnake, Moschino is a Stand user wielding Tangerine Dream.

An unnamed is a tertiary antagonist featured in Synchronicity in Morioh, a light novel based on Diamond is Unbreakable. It is an ordinary crow nesting on the roof of Trattoria Trussardi in Morioh that accidentally awakens a Stand. It uses its newfound power to hijack Tonio Trussardi's pantry so it can steal food for its chicks.

is a secondary antagonist featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable, specifically in the "Let's Go Hunting!" story arc. It and another rat were struck by Akira Otoishi with an Arrow, giving both of them identical Stands, both called Ratt.

is a secondary antagonist featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, specifically the "" story arc. It is a Rock Organism that preys on Lucy Steel and Joseph Joestar during their investigation of the Radio Gaga Incident.

, or simply , is a primary ally featured in Lonesome Tim, a light novel based on Steel Ball Run. She is a young Native American girl and the sole survivor of the Sand Readers, an indigenous tribe from the Arizona desert. Possessing a Stand that allows her to manipulate sand, she is escorted across the country by Mountain Tim to protect her from the notorious outlaw Reed Whipman.

is a secondary character featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable, introduced in the "Cats Love Yoshikage Kira" story arc. Originally a street cat hit by the Arrow, Tama is taken in by Yoshikage Kira after becoming a plant-Stand hybrid named Stray Cat.

is a Stand created by Kars that is an enhanced version of Whitesnake, featured in the light novel . uses his Whitesnake on Ultimate Kars causing a flood of DISCs to fall out of the Pillar Man. Kars immediately understands the ability and develops his own superior copy of the Stand.
, or simply , is a tertiary antagonist featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean. He is a painting by artist that was manifested by Bohemian Rhapsody.

is an unnamed posthumous tertiary character featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood. He was a scholar and leader of his university's archaeological group before turning into a vampire with the Stone Mask. His eventual death from the sunlight leads his son to spend decades finding the Stone Mask and researching any weaknesses it may have, in order to prevent more tragedies from occurring.
The was one of a trio of demons who impersonated Buddhas to steal fragrant oil from Gold Average Prefecture.
The was one of a trio of demons who impersonated Buddhas to steal fragrant oil from Gold Average Prefecture.
Jennifer Grey, better known as Jenny, is the FBI's Special Infiltration Agent and a master of Guns and serves as an ally during the DofD Tournament towards Ryōzanpaku.

better known as , was the Fifth Fist of Ragnarök and is currently one of the leading captains of the Shinpaku Alliance. He is also called "the Immortal Composer" due to the fact that he composes music by using his battles as inspiration for his melodies.

*Name: Left Hand Counter *Martial Art Style: Boxing and Underground Boxing *User: James Shiba *First Use: Battle 572 After being heavily attacked, Shiba counters with a powerful left straight to the back of the opponent's head.
AntiSora is a Pureblood Heartless who appears throughout the Kingdom Hearts series.

Brain is a Keyblade wielder who appears in Kingdom Hearts Union χ. He is a member of the Dandelions and was chosen by the Master of Masters to lead a Union after the Keyblade War, and he was one of Master Luxu’s Vessels until he left Brain, and went into another. Like the other new Union leaders, he was given a book with laws set by Ava. However Brain has declared he wishes to use the book to achieve a personal goal of his, wanting to be the virus that will alter the events set in stone.

Riku-Ansem is the form that Riku takes to capture Roxas, a mission requested by DiZ to assist with Sora's awakening. During his battle with Roxas in Kingdom Hearts 358/2 Days, Riku unleashed the dark power of that he had been hiding within him to defeat the latter. From thereon, Riku remains this way throughout most of Kingdom Hearts II. In this form, he appears identical to Ansem, other than his clothing, and even refers to himself as a pseudo-Ansem. After the Kingdom Hearts Encoder explodes while attempting to turn Kingdom Hearts into data, Riku is purged of Ansem's influence and transformed back into his normal form.
Vala is a character in Kingdom Hearts Dark Road. She is a Keyblade wielder and one of the upper classmen.

Barrierfreeman (バリアフリーマン) is initially seen during the Chojin Olympics: The Resurrection Arc, but later becomes one of the new Idol Chojin. He is a being formed by the fusion of two chojins: the calm and gentle Nils and the old and perverted Jiijoman.
Agatha, "the Hungry," was a powerful witch from Eldraine. She was the sister of Eriette, Hylda, and an unnamed witch who was the birth mother of the Kenrith twins.
Adila Rimehit is a priest and secretly a harborer of werewolves on the plane of Innistrad.

Aliban was a goblin wizard and personal attendant to Koskun Keep's first goblin king, Crank. When Crank was summoned away by a planeswalker, and Aliban was the only survivor of the Goblin upper class to survive the Great War. He thus became the second goblin king. He created Aliban's Towers, and his descendants also learned the spell. Given that hundreds of years have passed since his natural lifetime, it is likely that Aliban is long dead.
Arlen was a sorcerer of the Institute of Arcane Study on Dominaria.

Araithia Shokta, nicknamed "Rat", is a guildless girl from Ravnica who is torn between joining the Selesnyan, Gruul, and Rakdos guilds. However, she also has a second personality as the Dimir assassin Atkos Tarr.
Amalia Benavides Aguirre is a young vampire scout from Torrezon on Ixalan.
Onatah was an Anaba spirit crafter from Ulgrotha around the time of the Homelands (ca. 3800 AR).
Barl was the chief artificer of the Conclave of Mages during the Dark Age on Dominaria.
Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar (IPA: /æzməɹænoʊmɑɹdɪkədaɪstɪnəkuldəkɑɹ/), or Asmor for short, was a female wizard and a great cook from Dominaria.
Baki was a dwarven wizard attendant of unknown gender from the Council of Wizards on the Floating Isle on Ulgrotha around the time of the Homelands (ca. 3800 AR).
Arvad is a vampire, who once was a Benalish knight. He became security chief of Jhoira's crew on the rebuilt Skyship Weatherlight.
Bright-Palm, Soul Awakener, is a kitsune shaman of Kamigawa.
The Buried Lord, also called the Lord of the Interred, is a demon from Innistrad who was briefly returned to life before being banished by Liesa.
Bricen is an owlin mage-student at the Lorehold College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios.
Chondeah (sometimes spelled Chondaeh), was a young woman from the Kingdom of Shikar who was determined to be the most powerful wizard in the kingdom.

Chiyo was a soratami prophet, tactician and warrior from Kamigawa. She was the most advanced disciple of Uyo, the silent prophet, and a devoted follower and a right hand of Mochi, the Smiling Kami of Crescent Moon, the patron spirit of soratami.
Chianul, Who Whispers Twice is a Temur shaman who lives on Tarkir.
Clavileño was a Legion of Dusk vampire cleric from Ixalan. He was granted demonic power by Aclazotz before his death.
The Child of Alara is an avatar of Alara spawned by the Maelstrom comprised of all colors of mana.
Coernn was a sorcerer in the Dark Age of Terisiare, on the plane of Dominaria.

Crosis is one of the five Primeval Dragons of Dominaria. He was birthed by Piru and sired by Chromium Rhuell. His name means "death" in the ancient draconic language, and he is known as "The Purger." Crosis is a jet-black dragon who would slay his enemies by screaming the word of death, which caused anyone that heard it to instantly die. During the Fall of the Primevals, Crosis was imprisoned in a tar pit in Urborg by the black Numena Kuberr. He was freed thousands of years later by the other four Primevals, who sacrificed themselves to release him. Upon doing so, Crosis resurrected the others, completing the pantheon. Crosis was trapped again soon afterward following the deaths of Rith and
Davvol was the first evincar to rule the artificial plane, Rath.
Dina is a dryad mage-student at the Witherbloom College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios.
Deekah, Fractal Theorist, is a human wizard professor at the Quandrix College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios.
Dralnu was an undead necromancer from Urborg who aided the Coalition forces before betraying them. He bore a remarkable resemblance to the metathran commander Thaddeus.

Eladamri was the leader of the Skyshroud elves of Rath during the reigns of Volrath and Crovax. Though he was a skilled warrior, his greatest talent was his leadership, which he used first to unite the people of Rath in resistance against the evincars and later to tie together the various peoples of the Coalition on Dominaria.
Commander Eesha was an aven leader of the northern branch of the Order on Otaria, Dominaria.
Dreygar was a wizard of the Western Domains who, according to a Dominarian fable, overtook Aldon's Castle and ruled there as a tyrant.

Baron Eckhart Von Falkenrath was a leading member of the Falkenrath vampire bloodline on Innistrad. For many years, he was in league with the planeswalker Sifa Grent after she possibly killed his brother for disobeying her.
Draktha was a manipulative green-skinned mage who practiced black magic.

Endrek Sahr (EHN-drek SAHR) was a wizard affiliated with the Order of the Ebon Hand in Dominarian Sarpadia. Styling himself "Creator of Life and Race Architect", Sahr was responsible for creating the first thrulls as servants and objects of sacrifice for the Order.
Erebos (EH-reh-bohs) is the God of the Dead on Theros. He was compleated during New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse.

Emiel the Blessed is a legendary unicorn from the Adarkar Wastes, on the plane of Dominaria. Adarkar unicorns were considered the noblest creature in Terisiare, and seeing them was considered a great blessing. Kjeldoran priests thought that seeing a unicorn would protect you from any future harm. Others say that it would be the start of eight years of luck. Even if the details of the blessing differ, they all agree that seeing a unicorn forever changes one's life for the better. Unicorns think the same about seeing Emiel.
Extus Narr was a shadowy figure on Arcavios. He lurked in the shadows of Strixhaven and was the head of the Oriq.
Dean Embrose Lu is a human warlock teacher at the Silverquill College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios.
Ersta is a planeswalker unicorn, who is friendly to wizards. They are multicolor aligned.
Emry, Lurker of the Loch, is a merfolk wizard from Eldraine.
Ertha Jo is a kor advisor line-slinger from Zendikar who traveled to Thunder Junction following the opening of the Omenpaths.

Emilya was a 14-year-old girl and member of the Orzhov guild, who became a ghost after her death at the hands of the Cult of Rakdos. She has returned to life again by the touch of a nephilim and seeks vengeance on her former guild.
Eutropia, the Twice-Favored is a human wizard on Theros, favored by both Nylea and Thassa.

Fiers was a dwarf, revered as a god by Dominaria's dwarves and the Barbarian tribes on the Otarian continent of that plane. He was summoned by Karona as the deity of red magic, and might have been a planeswalker.
Garth (born Galin, nicknamed One-Eye) was a powerful wizard and planeswalker from Kush on Dominaria.
Flann was an ash treefolk of Lorwyn, known to most as the Wanderer, a giver of great knowledge.

Felisa Fang is a vampire wizard student at the Silverquill College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios. She is called Fang of the Silverquill which is a play on her last name. She is a Vainglory, a Silverquill mage that uses words to inspire or reproach their target.

Florin Ozbolt is a former Simic scientist who turned himself into Experiment One. As a human, he was an older man, slight and disheveled, with an impressive pair of eyebrows, thinning hair, and a stubbly chin. Until his transformation, he had an apprentice named Liana.
Glacian was an ancient Thran artificer who designed many of the Thran Empire's most powerful artifacts, including the powerstones on which Thran technology was based.

The planeswalker Grenfell Mor was of the founding sages of Minorad on Dominaria, and an advisor to the queen of Corundis. He was the father of Gwendolyn Carthalion (née Mor) and the grandfather of Jared Carthalion.

The Grugg brothers were three thrulls — Elbeph, Bephel, and Phleeb — who were servants of Teysa Karlov and accompanied her to the Utvara Reclamation Zone. Despite some of them being killed several times, Teysa always revived them. Only Bephel was able to speak at first, but Teysa later granted the gift of speech to Phleeb as well, in order to get information. She later created two more thrulls to join the original trio, dubbed Lepheb and Heblep.
Ghen is a Human Wizard from an unknown plane. He has the ability to manipulate the strands of mana that make up an enchantment.
Gutmorn, also known as the Feaster Upon Souls and Tormentor of the Seven Princes, is a demon of Innistrad.
Hakim Loreweaver was a historian and wizard from Suq’Ata on Dominaria. A charming and knowledgeable man, but also a bit of a braggart, he was called Loreweaver for his gift for telling stories.

Hivis of the Scale was a Viashino from the Great Desert of Dominaria. He was an ally of Jolrael. Hivis hailed from the vast reaches and possessed an uncanny ability to make dragons loyal to him, while his counterpart Zirilan of the Claw could lead the winged serpents. During the Mirage Wars, Hivis was able to lead viashino armies into Zhalfir, Femeref, and Suq'Ata, but was forced back after Jolrael defected from Kaervek's side.
Hikari (hee-KAH-ree; ) was a kami from Kamigawa, the guardian of the border between day and night.
Henrika Domnathi is the progenitor of the minor Domnathi vampire bloodline on Innistrad. She is the rumored one-time lover of Griselbrand.
Haldan is a Human Wizard from Ikoria. He is bonded with the monstrous Elemental Dog Pako.
Hogaak is a legendary avatar of graves from an unknown plane.
Inalla, Archmage Ritualist is a legendary human wizard from an unknown plane.
Iname (ee-NAH-may) is the kami of life and death on Kamigawa.
Intet (IHN-tet), the Dreamer, is a female primeval dragon on Dominaria in an alternate timeline.
Ilvoro was a merfolk lullmage mentor of Halimar with a Stonework Puma familiar who hired himself out as a guide across the Teeth of Akoum.
Kangee, was an aven wizard from Dominaria and a prominent member of The Order.

Ojer Kaslem is the Oltec god of growth and cultivation. As one of the Deep Gods of Ixalan's Core, she is believed to be a child of Chimil. She is one of the lesser gods, primarily worshipped by the Gardener Order.
